description: Kael Multiser TFT network analyzer with RS-485 (Modbus RTU)
source: Kael Elektronik, "Multiser-01-PC-TFT Hafıza Tablosu" (Modbus register table), program version V2.01

sources.title: Modbus hafıza tablosu üzerinden dosya okuma
sources.note: how the date registers and the microSD file area are used

notes: All registers are holding registers, one Modbus address per value. 8-bit values (U8 in the table) occupy a whole register.

Most measurements are scaled integers or floats that must also be multiplied by the transformer ratios in the same block: CTRF (current transformer ratio) and VTRFwM (voltage transformer ratio with multiplier, in tenths). The description of each register gives the multiplier printed in the table; the scale is the table's divisor.
The Real Time Date registers pack two bytes each: year (from 2000) and month, day and hour, minute and second, high byte first.
Energy in watt/second, var/second and VA/second is split into three 16-bit words (EH, H, L, most significant first).
The table does not give the word order of 32- and 64-bit values; big-endian is assumed.
The special commands at 0xFFFC-0xFFFF are executed by writing 0x55AA.
Not in this map: the scope signal buffers and the microSD remote file access area.
